description_en: Copies a database between ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances
description_zh: 该接口用于在RDS SQL Server实例间复制数据库
name: CopyDatabaseBetweenInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: target_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The names of the databases to be copied. Specify the names in the following format: `{"Source database name":"Target database name"}`. Separate multiple databases with commas (,). Examples:

Copy a single database: `{"zhttest":"zhttest"}`
Copy multiple databases: `{"zhttest01":"zhttest01","zhttest02":"zhttest02"}`

The name of the database in the target instance can be different from that in the source instance. However, before copying, make sure that the target instance does not contain a database with the same name
parameters.help_zh:
待复制的数据库名称列表，格式如下：`{"源实例的数据库名称":"目标实例的数据库名称"}`。复制多个库时，用英文逗号（,）分隔。示例如下：

复制单个库：`{"zhttest":"zhttest"}`
复制多个库：`{"zhttest01":"zhttest01","zhttest02":"zhttest02"}`

目标实例的数据库名称可与源实例不同，但复制前需确保目标实例中不存在同名数据库
parameters.name: db_names

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set of the source instance. When you copy a database based on a backup set, you can call the DescribeBackups operation to query the backup set ID.
When you call this operation, you must specify either BackupId or RestoreTime
parameters.help_zh:
源实例备份集ID。按备份集复制数据库时，可以通过查询备份列表接口DescribeBackups获取备份集ID。
调用接口时，BackupId和RestoreTime需传入任意一个
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore the database. You can select any point in time within the backup retention period. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. When you call this operation, you must specify either BackupId or RestoreTime
parameters.help_zh: 按时间点复制数据库，可以选择备份保留周期内的任意时间点。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 调用接口时，BackupId和RestoreTime需传入任意一个
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the replication of users and permissions. Valid values:
YES: Enables the replication of users and permissions. If the target instance contains a user with the same name as a user in the source instance, the permissions of the source user are added to the target user.
NO: Disables the replication of users and permissions. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否复制用户和权限，取值：
YES：表示复制用户和权限。如果目标实例中有同名的用户，则该用户将叠加源实例的同名用户的权限。
NO（默认值）：表示不复制用户和权限
parameters.name: sync_user_privilege
